d:
Major Lazer teams up with Indian artists Nucleya & Rashmeet Kaur for “Jadi Buti” which translates to ‘herb’ in Hindi.
As trailblazer of the desi bass movement in India, Nucleya’s role in developing the genre in India is no less significant than how Diplo and Major Lazer introduced global bass into the mainstream. It is fitting that Nucleya’s first release on Mad Decent is on the trio’s album, Music is The Weapon.
